los_focus.topic: Calculate and interpret financial ratios (5 categories)
los_focus.rationale: A.1 is the foundational LOS for Domain A. All subsequent LOS build on ratio computation fluency. Prioritizing A.1 establishes the core computational skills that A.2 through A.9 extend into analysis and evaluation.

los_focus.topic: Analyze profitability and limitations of ratio analysis
los_focus.rationale: A.2 transitions from computation (A.1) to interpretation â€” profitability analysis, ratio limitations. Pairing A.1 and A.2 in the first batch ensures both calculation accuracy and interpretive reasoning are established from the start.

select.rationale: Primary CMA exam format â€” the majority of candidates encounter 4-option select questions. Establishes the core pattern for distractor engineering.

numeric.rationale: Higher than pack-wide 8% to front-load calculation skill items. Early numeric items surface formula/arithmetic bugs before they propagate into later batches. Items: current ratio, quick ratio, inventory turnover, DSO, and DPO calculations.

multi.rationale: Multi-select tests ratio classification â€” candidates identify which ratios are liquidity vs. profitability vs. leverage. Front-loading multi items exercises the full breadth of ratio categories.

fill.rationale: One fill-in-the-blank item testing ratio terminology definitions (e.g., 'The ratio that measures a company's ability to meet short-term obligations is the ___ ratio'). Establishes fill pattern early.

match.rationale: One matching item pairing ratio names with their formulas. Establishes match-type rendering and scoring early.
